intro.title: Two moments of the planet, one in each ear.
intro.lead: NASA satellite data turned into music. The older year plays in your left ear, the newest in your right.
intro.startTouch: Headphones on, tap to start sound
intro.note: Starts with methane, oldest year against newest. Press D for Duet any time and ? for every shortcut.
birth.label: Your birth year (optional)
birth.hint: Leave empty to compare the oldest and newest years. Nothing is stored or sent.
birth.ok: Your Duet: {year} in your left ear, {newest} in your right.
birth.invalid: Type a four-digit year, like 2005, or leave it empty.
clamp.before: Records start in {used}, so {used} is used instead of {asked}.
clamp.after: Records end in {used}, so {used} is used instead of {asked}.
help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.lead: Every shortcut is also a button on screen. Sound is the main channel; nothing needs the mouse or the visuals.
key.duet: Duet on / off (left year, newest right)
key.flip: Switch view: Then and now / NASA EIC visualizations
key.ref: Duet: NOAA reference voice on / off
key.guess: Guess the Year / back to the jukebox
play.title: Play (Space)
pause.title: Pause (Space)
listenHelp.together: Left year in your left ear, right year in your right, at the same time.
listenHelp.turns: One bar of the left year, then one bar of the right, centred. Works on one speaker or one earbud.

story.wildfires: Global fire hasn't simply risen. Listen to the record jump year to year.
story.sea_level: The sea has risen almost every year. Listen for the pitch climbing.
story.air_quality: North China's air has cleaned up since its 2011 peak; northern India's has grown dirtier.
story.greenhouse_gases: Methane has climbed every year since 2007. Listen for higher, busier, faster.
aq.label: yearly mean NO₂ over {over}
eic.title: NASA SVS {svs}: {title}
active.sea_level: ocean at least 10 cm above the mean
active.air_quality: observed air above 5 ×10¹⁵ molec/cm² of NO₂
active.greenhouse_gases: air holding at least 1,900 ppb of methane
phys.fire.spoken: satellites saw {v} separate fire areas in an average 8-day window
phys.sea.spokenAbove: the average sea surface sits {v} centimetres above the 1993–2012 mean
phys.sea.spokenBelow: the average sea surface sits {v} centimetres below the 1993–2012 mean
phys.no2.spoken: average nitrogen dioxide is {v} times ten to the fifteen molecules per square centimetre
phys.ch4.spoken: average methane is {v} parts per billion
phys.fireEic.spoken: fire pixels cover {v} percent of the land
phys.seaEic.spokenAbove: the water stands {v} centimetres above the 1993 sea level
phys.seaEic.spokenBelow: the water stands {v} centimetres below the 1993 sea level
phys.no2Eic.spoken: nitrogen dioxide in view averages {v} times ten to the fifteen molecules per square centimetre
phys.ch4Eic.spoken: dense methane haze covers {v} percent of the globe
ref.levels.ch4: AIRS measures about 7 km up (400 hPa) and NOAA at the surface, so the levels differ; the trends should match.
ref.levels.sea: NOAA's record starts from 1993, the map from the 1993–2012 mean, so the levels differ; the trends should match.
gap.sameMonths: {label}: the other year is averaged over the same months.
gap.intro: Duet. {theme}{where}, {side}{a} in your left ear, {b} in your right.
gap.share: The share of {label} went from {from} to {to}.
gap.notes: Left plays {na} on a {ta}; right plays {nb} on a {tb}.
movedA.some: some way from the oldest year
movedB.some: some way from the first frame
map.wildfires: World map of every fire satellites detected in the year's fire season, drawn as orange dots over the night-time Earth
map.sea_level: World map of the year's average sea surface height: purple and blue where the ocean sits below its long-term mean, green near it, yellow, red and white above it; land is dark
map.air_quality: World map of the year's average nitrogen dioxide: pale yellow for clean air, orange to dark red over polluted regions
map.greenhouse_gases: World map of the year's average methane in the mid-troposphere: pale green for lower concentrations through orange to deep red for the highest
map.wildfires_eic: NASA Earth Information Center map of active fires seen by VIIRS: yellow and white specks of fire radiative power on dark land and a slate-blue ocean, with NASA's date stamp and colour bar in the lower left
map.sea_level_eic: NASA visualization of the sea seen through a porthole: sky above, blue water below, and a ruler in centimetres and inches up the middle with the 1993 sea level marked at zero
map.air_quality_eic: NASA TEMPO map of nitrogen dioxide over North America on a dark globe: light blue for clean air, cream through red to purple over polluted cities, dark where clouds or night hide the ground
map.greenhouse_gases_eic: NASA visualization of the globe wrapped in a purple haze of methane from the GEOS model, with a January-to-December timeline below
spoken.full: {label}. {value}. Playing {note}, {notes} notes per bar at {bpm} beats per minute, {timbre} tone, {harmony} harmony.
scrub.label: {title} timeline, {from} to {to}
scrub.duetOff: Unavailable in Duet mode, which always compares two chosen years.
groove.a: Each bar is one year, its height the year's value
groove.b: Each bar is one frame of NASA's visualization, its height the frame's {label}
say.whatA: then and now, year by year
say.eicView: NASA Earth Information Center visualization: {title}. {credit} Each frame plays as it appears.
say.duetOff: Duet off. Back to the {theme} timeline at {label}. Press Space to play.
say.refNeedsDuet: The NOAA reference voice plays in Duet. Press D first.
say.refNone: {theme} has no independent NOAA record to play.
say.refOn: NOAA reference voice on: a quiet centred voice plays NOAA's record for the same two years, one bar each.
say.jukebox: Jukebox. Choose a theme and press Space to play, or D for Duet.
say.motionOn: Reduce motion on. The planet holds still.
guess.title: Guess the Year
guess.card: A hidden year plays. Compare it with the oldest and newest, then pick which year it is.
guess.intro: A hidden year is playing. Compare it with the oldest and newest years, then pick the one you hear. Denser, faster, tenser sound means more of the theme's "active" signal.
guess.legend: Which year is the mystery? Keys 1 to 4
guess.round: New round. {theme}, somewhere between {y0} and {y1}. Press Space to hear the mystery year, A for {y0}, B for {y1}, then 1 to 4 to answer: {choices}.
guess.detail: {theme}, {label}: {what} {value}. It played {note}, {notes} at {bpm} BPM on a {timbre}.
guess.reveal: {verdict} The mystery was {label}, in {lean} of the record. {value}. It played {note}, {notes} notes per bar. Score {score} of {played}. Press Enter for the next round.
mapkey.marker: Map key: {title}. Each dot is a 1 km MODIS pixel where a fire burned during the fire season.
mapkey.gradient: Map key: {title} in {units}, from {first} at the low end to {last} at the high end.
mapkey.b.wildfires: NASA's colour bar is drawn in the frame, lower left: fire radiative power, 0 to 8 MW per pixel, red to white.
mapkey.b.sea_level: The ruler up the middle is the key: centimetres on the left, inches on the right, zero at the 1993 sea level.
mapkey.b.air_quality: NASA's colour bar is drawn in the frame: NO₂ from 0 (light blue) to 150 ×10¹⁴ molec/cm² (dark purple).
mapkey.b.greenhouse_gases: Purple haze is methane from NASA's GEOS model; the timeline under the globe shows the month.
